# Build Remote Agent — desktop gbr-agent

> MIT open-source PC agent (Windows / macOS / Linux). Pairs with the paid Build Remote Agent iOS/Android apps. Independent Linespotting AB product. Unified control layer for Grok Bot device routing.

Website: https://grokbuildremote.com/
Integrations: https://grokbuildremote.com/integrations.html
Compatibility: COMPATIBILITY.md (this repo) and https://grokbuildremote.com/COMPATIBILITY.md
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6791293726
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.grokbuildremote.app
Support: https://grokbuildremote.com/support
Ecosystem FAQ: https://grokbuildremote.com/#faq-ecosystem
Repo: https://github.com/LinespottingOrg/GrokBuildRemote-Agents
Release: https://github.com/LinespottingOrg/GrokBuildRemote-Agents/releases/tag/v0.6.0
Relay: https://gbr-relay.ekobrott.workers.dev/health  (live version 0.6.0; bot:true, fleet:true, classes)
Current binaries/train: v0.6.0

## Install
Preferred: docs/PINNED-INSTALL.md (GitHub Release v0.6.0 + SHA256SUMS). Convenience one-liners on the website are not for other repos' official docs.
Then: gbr-agent version

## What the phone sees
Terminal windows discovered on the paired PC (machine-wide mailbox / roster). Not headless OpenCode serve, CodeNomad sidecar, or Electron UIs. Sidecar :8788 = Bot API JSON, not a transcript. docs/WHAT-THE-PHONE-SEES.md

## Plugin registry (this repo)
plugins/README.md — Grok/Claude manifests, OpenCode mcp.servers, AiderDesk extension, gbr-mcp. We do not ship vendor pages into other projects' examples/.

## Pair
gbr-agent pair     # QR in browser AND printed 8-char code — phone scans or types
gbr-agent run      # keep running
Phone: Unpair in Settings before pairing a new mailbox. Force-close is not enough.
No fourth pair protocol.

## Integrations
Coding agents (Grok Build, Claude Code, Aider, Codex plugins, OpenCode, Goose, Cline, …) attach the same way: pair + :8788 / gbr-mcp. Grok plugin: .grok-plugin/plugin.json. Claude plugin: .claude-plugin/plugin.json. Skill: skills/gbr/SKILL.md. Goose: skills/goose/SKILL.md (TTY → phone; else user MCP gbr-mcp). Cline: skills/cline/SKILL.md (same). Do not PR pairing into block/goose or cline/cline — skills live here.
Mobile GUI frameworks (mobilerun, agent-device) drive a phone as a robot — different job; GBR spectates the *desktop* agent.

## Claw / Hermes / NemoClaw
Attach only via http://127.0.0.1:8788 or gbr-mcp. Skill: skills/openclaw/SKILL.md (same as skills/gbr/SKILL.md)
NemoClaw = sandbox; GBR = host tool.
Inbox: gbr-agent run watches GitHub boss-steer issues and injects into a matching Grok Build title.

## Bot API
Same PC: http://127.0.0.1:8788  (gbr-agent run; gbr-agent bot)
Remote:  GET/POST https://gbr-relay.ekobrott.workers.dev/v1/mb/{id}/bot/*   header X-GBR-Key
Phone Settings → Bot API copies URL + mailbox id + key.
Docs: docs/BOT-API.md
Grok Bot public beta: 2026-08-11.

## Device classes (0.6.0)
phone | linux | pc | laptop | mac_mini
GET /v1/devices  ·  GET /health
POST /v1/inject  {"device":"mac-mini"|"laptop"|"studio-linux"|"local"}
Unknown name → 404 (does not fall back to local). Phone is spectator.

## Companion remotes (loopback probes on GET /health)
- Amnibro/grok-remote :2421 — LAN plugin UI
- daniel-farina/grok-remote :7910/api/health — TypeScript Tailscale PWA
- ChrisP-Builds/grok-remote-hub :8787/health — Python hub, ok/stale/zombie
GBR Bot API stays on :8788. GitHub HTTPS relay is the control plane (not Tailscale).

## Debug
gbr-agent status | sessions | bot | fleet | netcheck | support-log
./scripts/gbr-diag.sh
Docs: AGENTS.md (AI), TROUBLESHOOTING.md, SESSION-NAMES.md, NETWORK.md, docs/BOT-API.md, FAQ.md

## Session names
0.5.0 capped at 6 sessions (stale conhost titles). 0.5.1 live roster, replace:true, max 255.
Rename: /rename in Grok Build, or gbr-agent rename -session ID -name "Title"

## Do not
Do not commit ~/.gbr, mailbox_key, wrangler.toml secrets.
Do not tell users to system-Clear-data if the app has Unpair (1.3.0+).
